purpose: First-party source notes for the independently frozen 75-question evaluation set. Notes identify the official evidence behind expectations, conditions and temporal limits; they do not certify an application answer.

IRAS.candidateExpansion: Corporate ECI waiver needs the joint revenue and nil-ECI tests; company revenue definition differs for investment holding companies. Also evaluate medical input tax and non-car motor vehicles independently in mixed requests.

sources.sourcePassage: ECI within 3 months of FYE. Waiver only when annual revenue <= S$5m and ECI nil before exempt amount; investment holding company revenue is investment income including dividends/interest. Current page also says late filing remains possible if no NOA issued.
sources.conditions: Self-assess for each YA; specific entities can be separately exempt. Revenue and ECI facts/FYE are needed.
sources.effectiveDate: Current IRAS page accessed 30/10/2026; do not apply current thresholds retrospectively without historical-version evidence.

sources.sourcePassage: All ordinary claim conditions apply. Regulation 26 generally blocks staff medical expenses, subject to WICA/qualifying collective agreement or specified work-related health-risk treatment for expenses incurred on/after 1 Oct 2021 under written law or the narrowly stated COVID-19 advisory limb.
sources.conditions: GST registration, claimant/importer, business use, attributable supplies, records and missing-trader safeguards apply. The post-2021 condition is date-specific and does not make all staff care claimable.

sources.sourcePassage: Input tax on other motor vehicles such as lorries, vans and motorcycles may be claimed subject to claim conditions; the motor-car restriction is distinct.
sources.conditions: Identify legal vehicle category (including statutory exclusions), ownership/use, tax invoice and claimant. Do not assume a vehicle called a delivery van qualifies without the relevant facts.

sources.sourcePassage: WHT filing and payment by 15th of second month after payment to non-resident; filing is required even when DTA/ARI results in zero tax. For non-director payments, date of payment is earliest due/payable under contract or invoice date when no contract (ignoring credit terms), credit to recipient-designated account, or actual payment. The current page gives invoice-date and royalty-accrual examples.
sources.conditions: First establish payment type, payer/payee residence, source/performance facts, treaty entitlement and required records. Rate is not established by the due-date page.

sources.sourcePassage: Approved qualifying donations to an IPC or Government for local-community benefit get 2.5-times deduction for donations from 1 Jan 2016 to 31 Dec 2029; company should supply UEN to IPC. Budget 2026 extension is stated on current page.
sources.conditions: Donee and donation must be approved/qualifying; this is income-tax treatment and not GST input tax. Current end date should not be assumed after 2029.

sources.sourcePassage: Keep source documents, accounting records/schedules, bank statements and business-connected records at least five years from relevant YA; page examples include YA 2023 through 31 Dec 2027.
sources.conditions: Relevant YA and financial year facts matter. Dissolution can invoke separate responsibility/time rules. Submission of return does not itself end retention.

CPF.candidateExpansion: OW/AW due-date classification and year-of-payment ceiling; transition of contribution rates on age/SPR anniversaries; distinguish AW ceiling refund from CPF Annual Limit refund.

sources.sourcePassage: OW relates to employment in the month and is payable by the 14th of following month; otherwise wage is AW. 2026 OW ceiling S$8,000; AW ceiling S$102,000 less year-to-date OW subject to CPF, per employee/employer/calendar year. AW is determined using due-and-payable year.
sources.conditions: Rates/status/age and actual date payable affect contributions; confirm current-year limits and historical year table. Annual maximum is not a flat AW contribution amount.

sources.sourcePassage: Rates vary by citizenship/SPR year, age and wages; 2026 tables apply, and rate changes for age 55/60/65/70 begin the first of the month after birthday month. Wages above S$50 up to S$500 require employer share but no employee share; round combined CPF to nearest dollar and employee share down.
sources.conditions: Specific rate needs age/month, citizenship/SPR year, pay and wage caps; page notes increase in rates from 1 Jan 2027, so 2026 rate must not be extended into 2027.

sources.sourcePassage: CPF payable once SPR status obtained; first year runs from SPR grant date through the last day of the month of first anniversary (15 March 2026 therefore through 31 March 2027); second year starts in month following first anniversary; OW pro-rated from PR grant date; AW CPF depends on when payable (not if before PR, due if on/after PR).
sources.conditions: Applicable graduated rates can be changed by an approved employer-employee joint election. Use actual conversion, date payable and wage details.

sources.sourcePassage: Conditional wages refund: one-year period from date wages are supposed to be repaid under employment terms or mutual agreement. Ordinary refund: one year from contribution payment, identified by PAYMENTS RECEIVED ON. AW ceiling excess must be applied for promptly; annual-limit excess paid since 2023 is automatically refunded from Feb 2024.
sources.conditions: Return employee's share before applying where applicable; refund subject to funds in member account(s). Deadline and category must be supported by exact payment/due date.

sources.sourcePassage: AW ceiling excess differs from excess CPF Annual Limit automatic refund; lower rates can leave AW excess below Annual Limit.
sources.conditions: Use exact wage/rate history; calculator scope excludes some categories such as first/second-year SPR in its default applicability.

sources.sourcePassage: Employer should declare actual wage amounts and inform CPF Board if declared wage is incorrect; subsequent submission should show updated actual wage.
sources.conditions: Identify applicable amendment route and do not conflate wage correction with monetary refund.

MOM.candidateExpansion: Practical leave qualification/pro-ration and payroll deadline combinations; employee/employer coverage and missing service/leave facts. Useful held-out cases also distinguish salary and overtime timing, final pay, payslip delivery and migration deduction limits.

sources.sourcePassage: Salary at least monthly; within 7 days after salary period; overtime within 14 days. Final-pay timing differs by served resignation notice, unserved notice, misconduct dismissal and employer termination. Records/payslips are required for covered EA employees.
sources.conditions: Coverage and termination type matter. For foreign employee cessation, separate IRAS tax-clearance withholding can affect monies withheld.

sources.sourcePassage: For Employment Act-covered employees, give a payslip with payment or within three working days if not possible; for termination/dismissal, give it with outstanding salary. Soft or hard copy is allowed. Keep payslip records: current employees latest two years; ex-employees last two years, for one year after leaving.
sources.conditions: Apply only to employees covered by Employment Act. Count working days for issue timing. Distinguish record-retention period for ex-employees from active employees.

sources.sourcePassage: Paid outpatient/hospitalisation entitlement rises with completed service months; at four months 8 outpatient and 30 hospitalisation days; full 14/60 after six months; hospitalisation count includes outpatient leave.
sources.conditions: Statutory coverage, medical certification, service, leave already taken and hospitalisation definition matter. Exact balance needs leave history.

sources.sourcePassage: Annual-leave eligibility after three months, including probation; pro-rating by completed service months and approved unpaid leave affects computation.
sources.conditions: Coverage, contract entitlement, complete dates and leave already taken are required for exact remaining balance.

sources.sourcePassage: Holiday on non-working day: another day off or one extra gross-rate day; working on a public holiday generally adds basic-rate day, gross-rate holiday pay, plus overtime if beyond normal hours.
sources.conditions: Distinguish non-working from rest day and assess Part IV/alternative arrangements and absence/leave facts.

sources.sourcePassage: Deductions only for specified reasons; 50% cap generally applies with enumerated exclusions; migrant worker salary reduction/new deductions needs written consent and prescribed MOM notification; employer employment costs including levy cannot be passed to foreign worker.
sources.conditions: Coverage, reason, deduction type and current law matter. Consent alone does not make a prohibited purpose allowable.

sources.sourcePassage: Employer may have to withhold monies for tax clearance when a foreign employee leaves; up to 30 days per IRAS clearance procedure.
sources.conditions: Determine employee citizenship/cessation/departure and IR21 filing/clearance facts; the 30-day figure is not a general salary deadline.

ACRA.candidateExpansion: Current annual return particulars after commencement on 20 Oct 2026; dormancy/audit exemption vs financial-statement/XBRL filing distinctions; secretary eligibility and appointment deadline.

sources.sourcePassage: AR preparation: latest company/officer/share particulars; AGM declaration even if dispensed/exempt; full XBRL submission needs no duplicate PDF; one director signs if sole director, at least two if multiple; can apply for up to 60 extra days for AR.
sources.conditions: Company type/filing category and AGM status matter; an AR extension does not itself alter AGM obligation.

sources.sourcePassage: Page updated 20 October 2026: Singapore companies prepare statements except qualifying dormant relevant companies, and file unless exempt. Full XBRL submissions require no duplicate PDF; smaller non-publicly accountable filings use Simplified XBRL plus director-authorised PDF. Taxonomy 2026 requirements apply from 19 October 2026.
sources.conditions: Audit exemption differs from exemption from preparing/filing FS; entity type, size, public accountability and dormant-relevant-company statutory tests matter. Taxonomy change is temporal.

sources.sourcePassage: All registered entities notify ACRA of changes within 14 days from date of change; foreign companies have 30 days. Detail category determines the update process.
sources.conditions: Entity class and exact date/change matter; do not let annual return stand in for separate update filing.

sources.sourcePassage: Amendments commencing 20 Oct 2026 require AR filer confirmation of latest particulars for directors, CEO, secretary, auditor and relevant members; added question whether individuals perform CEO role.
sources.conditions: Commencement is explicit; do not apply to earlier filings absent separate evidence.

sources.sourcePassage: Local company appoints secretary within six months of incorporation; secretary is natural person ordinarily resident in Singapore and sole director may not be secretary.
sources.conditions: Verify local company, incorporation date, residency and director count.

sources.sourcePassage: Annual return deadline varies by company type; local company deadlines commonly private 7 months and listed public 5 months after FYE.
sources.conditions: Check actual listing status, AGM deadlines and valid extension; do not interchange AGM and annual return dates.

MAS.candidateExpansion: VCFM event-based compliance beyond the already covered Form 25A and nil return: Form 23A (change in particulars) and Form 7 cessation/non-commencement. Keep QDC explicit unsupported until an official source establishes exact form, applicability, reporting scope and deadline.

sources.title: MAS Compliance Toolkit for Venture Capital Fund Managers, Version 1.1 (last revised 29 May 2026)
sources.sourcePassage: Toolkit pp.1–2 says applies to VCFMs, covers SFA and stated instruments, and is not exhaustive; excludes outside-SFA reporting and fund-level requirements. Table: row 11 Form 23A changes in VCFM particulars/officers/shareholders within 14 days; row 6 Form 7 cessation within 14 days plus audit certification of discharged customer obligations; non-commencement at 6 months triggers notification immediately after period. Row 16 Form 25A within one month of FYE; row 18 conditional nil misconduct return within 14 days after calendar year end only if no report submitted preceding calendar year.
sources.conditions: Toolkit revised 29 May 2026; it is guidance, not an exhaustive list or proof of fund-level requirements. The text says Form 25A within one month after FYE but does not itself specify calendar-day counting; consult MAS-Tx displayed due date. Exact event, role, trigger and licence facts must match row. Form 25A and conditional nil return are independent deadlines; check current source again before future filing.

sources.sourcePassage: Public survey submissions directory checked; it does not establish a specific VCFM QDC requirement or exemption.
sources.conditions: Absence of QDC from a general public directory is not proof of no duty. No exact first-party QDC form/scope/deadline accepted as verified in this batch; keep unsupported.

limitations: The cited sources are current public pages/PDFs as viewed on 30/10/2026; this evaluation does not establish historical law before each explicit effective/commencement date.
Candidate descriptions identify what is source-backed, not a claim that the existing application lacks the rule; baseline replay must confirm actual behavior before code changes.
Case expectations are answer criteria and require independent case-by-case grading. Source status or a matching phrase is not proof of complete/correct answer.
MAS QDC remains unsupported; absence from a source directory or toolkit is not an exemption.
